reason: I already book creators on a marketplace I know, and this one says right on the page that follower counts and results aren't verified. The escrow and promo codes are nice, but a lower fee doesn't make me switch when the thing I worry about most isn't solved.
objection: How do I know their followers are real? If it's all self-reported, I could pay $500 for a Reel that reaches bots, and the money-back only covers a missed deadline, not a fake audience.
would_change_my_mind: Follower counts and audience stats pulled directly from Instagram/TikTok and verified, so I can see real reach and engagement before I pay.
